title: Integrations
description: Connect code providers, alert channels, issue trackers and clouds.
noWorkspace: Pick a workspace to manage its integrations.

code.title: Code providers
code.description: Stored in the workspace and required for pull request reviews.

GITLAB.note: GitLab groups and projects, including self-hosted.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Where to hear when a scan finishes or a critical finding appears.
notifications.pendingReason: Outgoing alerts already work over webhooks: until a stored destination exists, a Connect button here would only accept a token and lose it.

slack.note: Messages in a channel or a specific thread.

issues.title: Issue tracking
issues.description: Open an issue in your tracker when a finding appears.
issues.pendingReason: This needs an integration credentials model that stores the token and the target project. That is backend work, not this screen.

jira.note: Issues with type, priority and assignee.

linear.note: Issues with team, cycle and labels.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Clouds where assets, accounts and deployments are discovered.
infrastructure.mcpNote: Connect an assistant with a token you already have, without writing the credential again.

cloudflare.note: Zones, DNS records and firewall rules.
